premises.text: People must check their phones constantly to manage dozens of apps and connected things

premises.text: A well-designed wall clock carries an embedded glanceable display, speaker, and open cloud platform

premises.text: The clock surfaces information from wearables, connected devices, and web services at the moment it is needed
premises.evidence_span: It shows you information from your wearables, connected devices, and web services right at the moment you need it

premises.text: Geometric ambient shapes make information readable at a glance without disruption

premises.text: An open-API cloud platform connects users' favorite apps
